title: Straight-tip catheter quantities above the allowance on the Continence Original Medicare Program
content:
A straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program may carry units above the straight-tip allowance of 200 units per 30 days. Those units rest on a practitioner record or on a signed liability notice.

## Rule

When no over-limit justification record qualifies, the above-allowance units ship only after a liability notice the customer signed for the straight-tip catheter, dated on or before the ship date, stands on the program.

1. **Record route.** A medical record whose purpose is over-limit justification qualifies when its visit date is no more than the tier's above-allowance record age before the ship date. On the Continence Original Medicare Program that age is 6 calendar months, counted in whole calendar months with a partial month not counted. When such a record qualifies and the newest written order and the newest kit order together ask more than the allowance of 200 per 30 days, the order's excess for the refill is added to the refill's units. It is never more than the newest written order's quantity for the tier's standard supply days, so the record carries the whole excess.
2. **Notice route.** When no such record qualifies and a liability notice for the straight-tip catheter, dated on or before the ship date, is on file, the order's excess for the refill is added, never more than the units on the newest such notice.
3. **Otherwise** nothing is added.

The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date. The newest kit order is the closed-system kit (A4353) order with the latest order date. On this tier the standard supply is 90 days, which is three 30-day blocks, so the record route's limit is three times the newest written order's quantity per 30 days.

## Record age

*Hypothetical:* for a ship date of 20 September, a visit on 21 February is 6 whole calendar months before, and the remaining partial month is not counted. That record qualifies. A visit on 20 February is 7 whole months before, so that record does not qualify.

## Truth table (hypothetical; newest order 260 and newest kit order 0 per 30 days; order's excess for the refill 180)

| Qualifying record? | Orders together above 200? | Straight-tip notice on file, dated on or before the ship date | Units added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes (260) | any | 180, within the limit of 260 times 3, which is 780 |
| yes | no (for instance an order of 190) | any | none |
| no | any | yes, newest notice for 120 units | 120, the notice's units |
| no | any | no | none |
